description: This file defines the PackageShortcutActivity class, which extends Android's Activity. It provides functionality for creating a launch intent with specific parameters, and manages the activity lifecycle by setting up a fragment to display a list of shortcuts based on the intent data.

classes.name: PackageShortcutActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that creates shortcuts for packages and loads a fragment to display shortcut options based on the intent data.

methods.name: getLaunchIntent
methods.description: Static method to create an intent to launch PackageShortcutActivity with specified target package, activity, user, and title.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets up the activity's view and initializes the fragment based on intent extras.
